# Replace opaque computational documentation filenames

[Task index](index.md) · [Previous](./docs.human-readable.architecture-development.md) · [Next](./docs.human-readable.contract-and-inventory.md)

## Status

`inactive`: Planned fifth child; blocked on architecture and development normalization, separate explicit activation required, and no automatic successor activation.

## Objective

Replace opaque numbered computational-document paths with descriptive topic-based paths while preserving scientific meaning, status, and Git history.

## Parent and prerequisites

- Parent: `docs.human-readable`
- Depends on: `docs.human-readable.architecture-development`

## Authorized scope

- Use the accepted inventory to rename and group computational pages in bounded topic families, preserving exact scientific content unless deterministic link or status corrections are required.
- Create a computational index organized by physical system, workflow stage, and evidence status rather than numeric filename codes.
- Update all maintained links and retain explicit mappings from former paths when needed for historical traceability.

## Completion criteria

- Current computational pages have descriptive lowercase kebab-case paths, the computational index explains their scientific and evidentiary status, and no current navigation depends on opaque numeric codes.
- Every renamed page preserves its applicable specification authority, scientific assumptions, provenance references, and Git history.
- All maintained links resolve and Sphinx passes with warnings as errors.

## Exclusions

- Do not change scientific settings, values, classifications, acceptance claims, calculation inputs or outputs, specifications, or execute scientific software.
- Do not rename the entire family in one unreviewable change or activate a successor automatically.
